**Windows 10/11 (64-bit):** `TeletextRescue-Setup-v1.2.exe` — the program with windows and `trcli`.
**Linux** (x86_64, ARM64) and **macOS** (Apple Silicon and Intel in one app): the program with windows (`TeletextRescue`, `Teletext Rescue.app`) and `trcli`. On macOS the first time: right click → Open, or `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine "Teletext Rescue.app" trcli`.

### What is new in 1.2

- **Japanese teletext (JTES)** — the whole service: 1400+ pages from a 1996 NHK recording, error correction up to 8 bits per line, every page assembled from all its copies and checked by CRC; photographic pictures, smooth mosaics, double-size characters, DRCS, raster colours, animations and tunes.
- **StarSight** titles and descriptions decoded, guide grid.
- **Gemstar GUIDE Plus+** programme table.
- **TV-Inform** (Russia), **Interactive Network**, AMOL text frames, VPS / WSS, the colour system of the VBI lines.
- Captions on any line, also from PAL tapes; PAL teletext from bttv captures.
- VBI line viewer (waveform, spectrum, eye diagram, colour as on a TV).
- Decoded recordings open again without decoding; one export for everything.
- The program with windows now runs on Linux and macOS too.
